comparisons.reason: Different targets. Feature 0 returns 1 when a comment engages a specific OP example or premise cited in the argument. Feature 52 returns 1 when a comment engages the OP's main or central claim at the general level, and it explicitly excludes comments aimed at specific examples or anecdotes. The two can be 1 and 0 on the same row. The null rules also differ: feature 0 is null when OP context is insufficient, while feature 52 is null when the title is missing. Feature 52 also requires engagement at the general level, and feature 0 does not.
